criteria.text: The canonical course-gen-platform start command loads the compiled API entrypoint under Node 24 without ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from extensionless relative ESM imports.
A safe real-command regression check proves module resolution reaches a known missing-configuration boundary without loading repository environment files or contacting external services.
The CI type-check job verifies the built start runtime, and package documentation matches the tsx runtime already used by the production container.
